caption: Account summary on the free plan: 'Basic (Free) Account', 10 responses per survey and survey data storage in the United States; the username and avatar initials are hidden.

A draft survey with a Multiple Textboxes question: the panel says the Basic plan only lets you preview paid features and question types, and the question is listed as an added paid feature; the avatar initials are hidden.
Analyze results on Basic: 'New export' and 'Previous exports' are locked, with the panel 'Good data deserves a way out' and an Upgrade button; the avatar initials are hidden.
The pricing page opens on Team plans: Team Advantage €30 and Team Premier €75 per user per month, starting at 3 users, billed annually; the avatar initials are hidden.

The Individual plans tab: Standard Monthly €39 a month billed monthly, Advantage Annual €36 a month (€432 billed annually), Premier Annual €99 a month (€1,188 billed annually); the avatar initials are hidden.
Checkout for Standard Monthly with the Netherlands pre-filled: single user €39, 'Total (VAT included) €39', monthly billing; the billing email is hidden.
